title: 第21章  谢京墨不要呀第22章  她抖的厉害
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
季欢看到是他的时候，双眼微微一撑，抱着谢烬沉的手变成了推拒。
谢烬沉不舍，他握住推他的手，又加深了这个吻。
季欢被他吻得呜咽了一声，她觉得丢脸死了，阖下眸子，不敢再与谢京墨对视。
直到听到啪的一声关门声，谢烬沉才松开了她，他呼吸很重。
他看她的目光里充满了火光，这就是18岁的少年。
正是血气方刚的年纪，欲望也比较强。
季欢双眼里噙着泪，目光却是看着谢京墨房间的门。
他一直警告她，不许她接近谢烬沉，刚刚他又看到他们两人在接吻。
他一定觉得，她故意勾引谢烬沉的。
其实她也不想，也想把这小子给甩掉。
偏偏，他像狗皮膏药一样粘着自己。
而且，还让她不反感。
谢烬沉这时才看了眼那道门。
“我小叔还没睡吗？”
他知道那间房间住的是谢京墨，季欢点了一下头。
“他刚刚看到我们接吻了，怎么办？”
谢烬沉好笑，“看到就看到呗，有什么害羞的？”
谢烬沉宠溺地摸了摸她的脸。
“你先进去，进去了我再走。”
季欢好笑，这家伙真的是太粘人了，这样的画面，她以前只在小说和电视里见过。

此时她感受到了，嘴角划出一抹好看的笑容。
“晚安！”
“晚安！”
季欢开了门，进门后，她把门给关上。
季欢锁上门，笑着走到床边，倒进柔软的大床里，有一点点恋爱的感觉。
季欢缓了一会，才上床，脱去外衣，开始睡觉。
这床很舒服，她躺下没一会就睡着了。
半夜，她被渴醒。
她开了灯，看了一眼时间，凌晨的三点半。
她轻呼一声，这也太早了。
可是，真的好渴。
昨晚那剁椒鱼头，她吃得有点多，那道菜比较咸。
现在好了，半夜被渴醒，还不是在自己的家里。
她轻呼一声，好困呀！
content_en:
When Ji Huan saw it was him, his eyes widened slightly, and the hand holding Xie Jinchen turned into rejection.
Xie Jin was reluctant to let go. He held the hand that pushed him and deepened the kiss.
Ji Huan sobbed when he kissed her. She felt so embarrassed that she closed her eyes and did not dare to look at Xie Jingmo again.
It wasn't until he heard the slam of the door that Xie Jinchen let go of her. He was breathing heavily.
The way he looked at her was full of fire, this was the 18-year-old boy.
It is the age when the blood is strong and the desire is relatively strong.
Ji Huan's eyes were filled with tears, but he was looking at the door of Xie Jingmo's room.
He had been warning her not to get close to Xie Jinchen, and just now he saw the two of them kissing.
He must have felt that she deliberately seduced Xie Jinchen.
In fact, she didn't want to and wanted to get rid of this guy.
However, he stuck to himself like a dog-skin plaster.
Moreover, it also made her not disgusted.
Only then did Xie Jinchen glance at the door.
"Isn't my uncle still asleep?"
He knew that Xie Jingmo lived in that room, and Ji Huan nodded.
"He just saw us kissing, what should we do?"
Xie Jinchen was amused, "Just see it when you see it. What's there to be shy about?"
Xie Jin touched her face lovingly.
"You go in first, and then I'll leave."
Ji Huan is funny. This guy is really too clingy. She has only seen this kind of scene in novels and TV before.
At this time, she felt it, and a beautiful smile appeared on the corner of her mouth.
"Good night!"
"Good night!"
Ji Huan opened the door. After entering, she closed the door.
Ji Huan locked the door, walked to the bed with a smile, and fell into the soft big bed, feeling a little bit in love.
Ji Huan calmed down for a while before going to bed, taking off his coat and starting to sleep.
The bed was very comfortable and she fell asleep shortly after lying down.
In the middle of the night, she was woken up by thirst.
She turned on the light and looked at the time, which was three-thirty in the morning.
She whispered, it was too early.
But, I am really thirsty.
She ate a little too much of the fish head with chopped pepper last night, and that dish was quite salty.
It's okay now. I was woken up by thirst in the middle of the night, and I wasn't even in my own home.
She exclaimed softly, so sleepy!
